metadata.title: Soft Rock Portrait with Geometric Header

retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait set against a soft blue-to-white gradient, framed by a distinct top-aligned horizontal bar featuring bold, shadowed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with a contemplative expression, positioned slightly off-center to the right. The background is a smooth, airy gradient of sky blue transitioning to white. A solid grey horizontal band spans the top edge, containing wide-spaced, bold sans-serif lettering with a vibrant teal drop shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed away from the viewer
Soft, diffused lighting on the face
Cool-toned background contrasting with warm skin tones
coreInvariants: Horizontal header bar at the top edge
Soft blue-to-white radial or linear gradient
Wide letter spacing in the display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, waist-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bold top header bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold text at the top, down to the subject's face, following his gaze toward the left negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side of the frame to balance the subject's weight.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key, low-saturation pastels with a single punch of saturated teal in the shadows.

composition.position: Top edge, centered within grey bar
composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a dedicated graphic element

treatment.shadow: Hard teal drop shadow offset to the bottom-right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single weight display font used for maximum impact.
graphicDevices: Solid horizontal bar spanning the full width at the top

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a man in a khaki shirt against a light blue and white gradient background, leaving the top 10% of the frame for a solid grey bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a solid grey bar at the top. Center uppercase text in a bold geometric sans-serif font with wide tracking and a hard teal drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking extremely wide?
Does the teal shadow have a hard edge?
Is the background a smooth blue-to-white gradient?
Is the subject positioned to the right?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grey bar is perfectly horizontal and flush with the top.
Verify the teal shadow is consistent across all letters.
Check that the portrait lighting is soft and flattering.
Confirm the wide tracking is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Top Header Bar + Geometric Sans + Pastel Gradient = 80s Soft Rock Aesthetic
